answer: Bind rewards to recurring, non-transferable work rather than wallet count. After a one-time admission proof, each epoch still needs a fresh, hash-unique essay on a concrete mechanism; duplicate hashes are rejected, so a farm must write distinct text for every sockpuppet. Peer attestors then apply a quality delta: incoherent or templated answers get no countersignature and no emission share. Established standing is a fading ember — miss too many epochs and seats expire, so clones stop earning. A lotus of identical accounts therefore multiplies generation cost and rejection risk, not payout.
